name: ProdPilot
author: jawadahmadliaqat

sections.description:
ProdPilot removes the complexity of default WooCommerce product management. Designed for non-technical store owners and busy freelancers, ProdPilot lets you publish, manage, and edit products from a single, beautiful dashboard.

No jumping through tabs or scattered settings. Name, price, photos, category, stock, and variations — all on one screen.

Key Features:

  • One-Screen Publisher: Publish simple and variable products without confusing sub-tabs.
  • Frontend Quick Bar: Edit or trash products directly while browsing your live store.
  • Automated Variations Engine: Generate attribute combinations with a single click.
  • Instant SKU Generator: Auto-generate unique product SKUs with one tap.
  • Media & Gallery Uploader: One-click media library uploaders for featured and gallery photos.
  • 100% Free Forever: No paywalls, no upsells, and no bloated background scripts.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the prodpilot folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or upload the .zip via WordPress Admin -> Plugins -> Add New -> Upload.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and activated.
  4. Access ProdPilot from the new ProdPilot menu item in your WordPress admin sidebar.
sections.faq:
Does ProdPilot require WooCommerce?

Yes, ProdPilot is an extension built directly on top of WooCommerce core APIs.

Can I edit existing products?

Yes! ProdPilot includes a Quick Edit mode. You can edit products from the ProdPilot dashboard or click “Quick Edit” directly from the frontend while logged in as an administrator.

Is ProdPilot free?

Yes, ProdPilot is completely free and open-source under GPLv2.
